AI: YOUR MOVE

FACILITATOR FIELD NOTES

Make room for disagreement.

One shared device per team of 3–6. Assign a facilitator, a scribe and a rotating challenger. Participants vote privately by passing the device, then reveal together.

  1. Briefing · 2 minutes. Choose a team name and difficulty.
  2. Seven dilemmas · 4 minutes each. Read and vote (45s), reveal and discuss (75s), consider the twist (60s), record the decision (60s).
  3. Three moves · 6 minutes. Choose priorities and assign owners, first steps and evidence.
  4. Closing pitch · 2 minutes. Read your shared ambition and defend your priorities.

The 38-minute clock is advisory. Pause whenever needed. Time expiring never deletes work or forces a decision. Round timers reset when opening a round. Standard explores the original dilemma. Stretch adds a constraint. Boardroom adds a second challenge and requires a mitigation.

There is no universal right answer. Completion measures recorded decisions, not leadership competence. For PROTECT, all three review areas need attention.

Progress stays in this browser when storage is available. There is no live multiplayer or server submission. Export your report before leaving a shared device. Reset clears the local session.
